records.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a race condition in the `import` method. Looking at the diff, lines 17-38 of topic_embed.rb show that when creating a new embed, there's a `Topic.transaction` block (lines 20-28), but when updating an existing embed (lines 29-37), the `revisor.revise!` call and `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` are outside any transaction.
